agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, April 22, 2026 in Transit Committee Report 25.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, April 8, 2026, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on Thursday, April 9, 2026.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The following Transit Services Department staff provided a presentation on the item, and answered questions from the Committee. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
The following staff also responded to questions from Committee:
The residents Ajay Ramachandran, Kyle Humphrey and Noah Vineberg spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the item.
Written correspondence was received from Jan Lam, dated April 7, 2026.
Councillor Tierney raised a Point of Order with regard to Councillor Leiper's comments and line of questioning when addressing Ajay Ramachandran's delegation, stating that it does not relate to the item before Committee. The Chair ruled on the Point of Order and allowed the delegation to answer Councillor Leiper's question. 
Councillor Hill raised a Point of Order with regard to Councillor Menard's line of questioning when addressing Ajay Ramachandran's delegation, stating that parking related matters do not relate to the item before Committee. The Chair ruled on the Point of Order and allowed the delegation to answer Councillor Menard's question.
